$comment: Craftable materials. No composition here on purpose - it is derived from recipe inputs by tools/build-content.mjs so the numbers can never drift from the tech tree.

materials.name: Cord
materials.description: Fiber twisted against itself until it stops being weak.

materials.name: Rope
materials.description: Cord laid into cord. Will hold a person, probably.

materials.name: Whetstone
materials.description: One stone ground flat against another. Makes edges out of intentions.

materials.name: Ember
materials.description: A caught spark, nursed into something that will survive being carried.

materials.name: Torch
materials.description: Fire on a stick. Still the single best invention anyone has managed.

materials.name: Stone Axe
materials.description: Crude, heavy, effective. Bites wood far better than your hands did.

materials.name: Flint Knife
materials.description: A knapped edge lashed to a haft. Sharper than iron, for about a day.

materials.name: Snare
materials.description: Patience, arranged into a loop.

materials.name: Bow
materials.description: Stored intent. The stick does the work; the cord only remembers.

materials.name: Field Kiln
materials.description: Packed clay around a held fire. The first machine anyone builds.

materials.name: Bone Charm
materials.description: Carved and strung. Superstition, unless it works, in which case: alchemy.

materials.name: Glow Tonic
materials.description: Steeped glowcap. Drinking it makes your veins faintly visible. Mildly alarming.

materials.name: Resin Bandage
materials.description: Fiber and sap. Seals a wound and takes the hair with it later.

materials.name: Pitch
materials.description: Resin cooked down to something black, patient, and extremely flammable.

materials.name: Wind Sash
materials.description: Woven gale moss. Pulls very gently forward, always.

materials.name: Glass
materials.description: Sand persuaded by heat to become honest.

materials.name: Firebrick
materials.description: Fired clay that shrugs off the heat that made it.

materials.name: Forge
materials.description: Brick stacked into a throat that swallows air and spits out metal.

materials.name: Glass Flask
materials.description: Blown thin and bound at the neck. The alchemist's actual first tool.

materials.name: Fire Flask
materials.description: Pitch in glass. Throw it, then be somewhere else.

materials.name: Ember Vial
materials.description: A bloom sealed while still hot. Stays warm for a season.

materials.name: Obsidian Shard
materials.description: Struck free with a hammer, because nothing softer would do it.

materials.name: Obsidian Spear
materials.description: Reach, plus an edge that does not forgive.

materials.name: Iron Ingot
materials.description: Ore, minus everything that was not iron.

materials.name: Silver Ingot
materials.description: Poured bright and cooled slow. Conducts more than heat.

materials.name: Iron Hammer
materials.description: The tool that makes the tools. Everything downstream owes it.

materials.name: Iron Blade
materials.description: Ground to an edge and not yet given a handle. Awkward. Dangerous.

materials.name: Iron Chain
materials.description: Links that only fail one at a time.

materials.name: Iron Sword
materials.description: Blade, grip, and the whole long argument between them settled.

materials.name: Silver Mirror
materials.description: Backed glass. Shows the room, and occasionally the room next to it.

materials.name: Focusing Lens
materials.description: Glass grown around a crystal seed. Bends light into a decision.

materials.name: Lantern
materials.description: A torch that has learned manners. Throws light where you point it.

materials.name: Resonator
materials.description: Silver wound around a shard. Hums at whatever frequency you were about to need.

materials.name: Rune Stone
materials.description: Aetherdust ground into cut stone. The marks were not there when you started.

materials.name: Bound Sigil
materials.description: A rune given a voice. It answers now, which is the entire problem.

materials.name: Aether Lens
materials.description: Focuses something that is not light. Uncomfortable to look through.

materials.name: Void Shard
materials.description: Voidglass broken correctly. There is an incorrect way, and it is worse.

materials.name: Void Blade
materials.description: An edge that arrives slightly before the swing.

materials.name: Orb Focus
materials.description: Sigil and lens seated together. The orbs stop feeling like pockets and start feeling like hands.

materials.name: Maelstrom Key
materials.description: Not a key to a door. A key to the thing the door was built to keep out.
